document.description: CbcV (PA5376) is the ATP-binding and hydrolyzing component of the Cbc ABC importer in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1. It energizes the CbcW membrane component, while associated binding proteins specify choline, glycine betaine, carnitine and, in characterized CosX-containing combinations, choline-O-sulfate. Its ATPase acts on the cytoplasmic side of the transport assembly by the conserved ABC mechanism. Substrate import supplies nutrients for downstream catabolic enzymes; CbcV is not a sulfate-specific pump or a substrate-degrading enzyme.

review.reason: Refine the substrate-class assignment to the measured QAC transport mechanism or its supported substrate-specific processes. This is a lateral chemical-class correction, not removal of transport or a disagreement based on the number of PAINT seeds. The assayed PAO1 core was expressed in compatible heterologous systems; PA14 native mutant evidence is distinguished from PAO1 construct identity. The protein contributes its subunit role to the shared core and substrate specificity depends on the binding partner. PAINT places the ancestral claim at PANTHER:PTN002466744. document.description: CbcW (PA5377) is the multipass inner-membrane permease of the shared Cbc ABC importer in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1. It forms the translocation component with the CbcV ATPase and recruits substrate-binding proteins that confer specificity for choline, glycine betaine or carnitine. Heterologous combinations with CosX also support choline-O-sulfate uptake. Substrate recognition and transport require compatible partners; CbcW does not itself hydrolyze ATP or chemically degrade these nutrients.

genes/PSEAE/cbcV/cbcV-notes.md.text:
## 2026-11-07 — independent PAO1 consultation

Official PAO1 records and the cloned locus identify PA5376/Q9HTI8 as CbcV, the shared ABC ATPase. ATP binding/hydrolysis supplies energy to CbcW-dependent import, with substrate specificity supplied by compatible binding proteins. Full PMID23763788 methods/results concern organic choline-O-sulfate with CosX, so inorganic-sulfate mappings are corrected without rejecting the experiment on species grounds. The family-derived osmotic-response claim remains UNDECIDED: growth and osmolarity dependence do not establish an unrestricted stress role or its absence. No new annotation was added.

Source scope and access receipts are preserved in [primary-scope](../../../analysis/module_audits/bacterial_l_carnitine_catabolism/pseae-consultation/primary-scope.md). The genuine Falcon attempt failed with HTTP 403 authentication/access rejection; no provider report was invented. The original ordered source payloads and protected caches remain intact. The mapped PANTHER lineage has no reported IRD/IKR loss. All primary source quotations are distinguished from analyst interpretation.

description: 'CbcV (PA5376) is the ATP-binding and hydrolyzing component of the Cbc ABC importer in Pseudomonas
  aeruginosa PAO1. It energizes the CbcW membrane component, while associated binding proteins specify
  choline, glycine betaine, carnitine and, in characterized CosX-containing combinations, choline-O-sulfate.
  Its ATPase acts on the cytoplasmic side of the transport assembly by the conserved ABC mechanism. Substrate
  import supplies nutrients for downstream catabolic enzymes; CbcV is not a sulfate-specific pump or a
  substrate-degrading enzyme.'

<!DOCTYPE html>

        <p>CbcV (PA5376) is the ATP-binding and hydrolyzing component of the Cbc ABC importer in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1. It energizes the CbcW membrane component, while associated binding proteins specify choline, glycine betaine, carnitine and, in characterized CosX-containing combinations, choline-O-sulfate. Its ATPase acts on the cytoplasmic side of the transport assembly by the conserved ABC mechanism. Substrate import supplies nutrients for downstream catabolic enzymes; CbcV is not a sulfate-specific pump or a substrate-degrading enzyme.</p>

                <h2 id="2026-11-07-independent-pao1-consultation">2026-11-07 — independent PAO1 consultation</h2>
<p>Official PAO1 records and the cloned locus identify PA5376/Q9HTI8 as CbcV, the shared ABC ATPase. ATP binding/hydrolysis supplies energy to CbcW-dependent import, with substrate specificity supplied by compatible binding proteins. Full PMID23763788 methods/results concern organic choline-O-sulfate with CosX, so inorganic-sulfate mappings are corrected without rejecting the experiment on species grounds. The family-derived osmotic-response claim remains UNDECIDED: growth and osmolarity dependence do not establish an unrestricted stress role or its absence. No new annotation was added.</p>
<p>Source scope and access receipts are preserved in <a href="../../../analysis/module_audits/bacterial_l_carnitine_catabolism/pseae-consultation/primary-scope.md">primary-scope</a>. The genuine Falcon attempt failed with HTTP 403 authentication/access rejection; no provider report was invented. The original ordered source payloads and protected caches remain intact. The mapped PANTHER lineage has no reported IRD/IKR loss. All primary source quotations are distinguished from analyst interpretation.</p>

        // Add collapsible functionality
        document.querySelectorAll('.collapsible').forEach(element => {
            element.addEventListener('click', function() {
                this.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            });
        });

        // Voting functionality
        const VOTE_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwPKH7d3seuPNBtB0ugVjqGeTiByyOGD5vkqB_Ck6K8eOcPQYbJqBOuz6GFgXHKBNWK/exec';

        // Get or create session ID
        let sessionId = localStorage.getItem('review_session_id');
        if (!sessionId) {
            sessionId = 's' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
            localStorage.setItem('review_session_id', sessionId);
        }

        // Show previous votes on page load
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.vote-buttons').forEach(container => {
                const key = `vote_${container.dataset.g}_${container.dataset.a}_${container.dataset.act}`;
                const previousVote = localStorage.getItem(key);
                if (previousVote) {
                    const btn = container.querySelector(`[data-v="${previousVote}"]`);
                    if (btn) btn.classList.add(previousVote === 'up' ? 'voted' : 'voted-down');
                }
            });
        });

        // Handle vote clicks - Simple image beacon approach
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (!e.target.classList.contains('vote-btn')) return;

            // Prevent the click from bubbling to parent elements (like summary)
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            const btn = e.target;
            const container = btn.closest('.vote-buttons');
            if (!container) return;

            const voteType = btn.dataset.v;

            // Check if already voted (locally)
            const key = `vote_${container.dataset.g}_${container.dataset.a}_${container.dataset.act}`;
            const previousVote = localStorage.getItem(key);

            if (previousVote === voteType) {
                // Same vote - do nothing
                btn.style.animation = 'shake 0.5s';
                setTimeout(() => btn.style.animation = '', 500);
                return;
            }

            // Build URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams({
                gene_id: container.dataset.g,
                annotation_id: container.dataset.a,
                ref_id: container.dataset.r || '',
                action: container.dataset.act,
                vote: voteType,
                session_id: sessionId,
                ua: navigator.userAgent.substring(0, 100)
            });

            // Clear previous vote styling
            container.querySelectorAll('.vote-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('voted', 'voted-down');
            });

            // Apply new vote styling immediately (optimistic UI)
            btn.classList.add(voteType === 'up' ? 'voted' : 'voted-down');

            // Store locally
            localStorage.setItem(key, voteType);

            // Send vote using fetch with no-cors mode (fire and forget)
            const fullUrl = VOTE_URL + '?' + params;
            console.log('Sending vote to:', fullUrl);

            // Use fetch in no-cors mode - we won't get a response but the request will be sent
            fetch(fullUrl, {
                mode: 'no-cors',
                method: 'GET'
            }).then(() => {
                console.log('Vote request sent (no response due to no-cors mode)');
            }).catch(err => {
                console.warn('Vote may not have been recorded, but saved locally:', err);

                // Fallback: try image beacon as well
                const img = new Image();
                img.src = fullUrl;
            });
        });

        // Optional: Add shake animation for feedback
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
            @keyframes shake {
                0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
                25% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
                75% { transform: translateX(5px); }
            }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    </script>

genes/PSEAE/cbcW/cbcW-notes.md.text:
## 2026-11-07 — independent PAO1 consultation

Official PAO1 records and the cloned locus identify PA5377/Q9HTI7 as CbcW, the membrane permease, not the adjacent CbcX binding protein. CbcW contributes translocation to the shared ABC importer; CbcV supplies ATP hydrolysis. PAO1 constructs, native PA14 mutants and heterologous B728a binding partners are kept distinct. CosX-dependent choline-O-sulfate transport (PMID23763788) is an organic-sulfur cargo observation, not inorganic sulfate transport. The membrane inference is independently consistent with the curated transmembrane features. No new annotation was added.

Source scope and access receipts are preserved in [primary-scope](../../../analysis/module_audits/bacterial_l_carnitine_catabolism/pseae-consultation/primary-scope.md). The genuine Falcon attempt failed with HTTP 403 authentication/access rejection; no provider report was invented. The original ordered source payloads and protected caches remain intact. The mapped PANTHER lineage has no reported IRD/IKR loss. All primary source quotations are distinguished from analyst interpretation.

  id: NCBITaxon:208964
  label: Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1
description: 'CbcW (PA5377) is the multipass inner-membrane permease of the shared Cbc ABC importer in
  Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1. It forms the translocation component with the CbcV ATPase and recruits
  substrate-binding proteins that confer specificity for choline, glycine betaine or carnitine. Heterologous
  combinations with CosX also support choline-O-sulfate uptake. Substrate recognition and transport require
  compatible partners; CbcW does not itself hydrolyze ATP or chemically degrade these nutrients.'

- id: PMID:19919675
  title: The ATP-binding cassette transporter Cbc (choline/betaine/carnitine) recruits multiple
    substrate-binding proteins with strong specificity for distinct quaternary ammonium compounds.
  findings:
  - statement: The shared Cbc core consists of the CbcW permease and CbcV ATPase and recruits
      distinct substrate-binding proteins.
    supporting_text: a transmembrane protein (CbcW) and an ATPase (CbcV)
  reference_review:
    relevance: HIGH
    correctness: VERIFIED
    review_notes: Full text read. PAO1 CbcWV constructs, PA14 native mutants and B728a binding
      proteins/heterologous hosts are distinguished. Table5 CaiX specificity reconstitution is not
      relabeled as a fully native PAO1 assay. The core supplies transport, not substrate chemical
      breakdown.
- id: PMID:21478341
  title: Roles of three transporters, CbcXWV, BetT1, and BetT3, in Pseudomonas aeruginosa choline
    uptake for catabolism.
  findings:
  - statement: CbcXWV supports choline-dependent growth; transporter contributions depend on
      osmolarity.
    supporting_text: BetT3 and CbcXWV, but not BetT1, were sufficient to support growth on choline.
  reference_review:
    relevance: HIGH
    correctness: VERIFIED
    review_notes: Full ASM text read externally; protected abstract cache unchanged. PA14 mutants
      and PAO1 cbcXWV complementation are explicit. Uptake-dependent growth and osmolarity effects
      do not make the transporter a substrate-degrading enzyme.
- id: PMID:23763788
  title: The widespread plant-colonizing bacterial species Pseudomonas syringae detects and exploits
    an extracellular pool of choline in hosts.
  findings:
  - statement: Bacterial reporters and uptake mutants test access to plant choline compounds; the
      full article also tests the CosX-dependent choline-O-sulfate configuration.
  reference_review:
    relevance: HIGH
    correctness: VERIFIED
    review_notes: Full Wiley text read externally; protected abstract cache unchanged. Figure5 uses
      choline-O-sulfate/CosX and the shared core, not inorganic sulfate. PAO1 core construct
      provenance traces to PMID19919675; the host and binding proteins are P. syringae B728a.

    <script>
        // Add collapsible functionality
        document.querySelectorAll('.collapsible').forEach(element => {
            element.addEventListener('click', function() {
                this.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            });
        });

        // Voting functionality
        const VOTE_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwPKH7d3seuPNBtB0ugVjqGeTiByyOGD5vkqB_Ck6K8eOcPQYbJqBOuz6GFgXHKBNWK/exec';

        // Get or create session ID
        let sessionId = localStorage.getItem('review_session_id');
        if (!sessionId) {
            sessionId = 's' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
            localStorage.setItem('review_session_id', sessionId);
        }

        // Show previous votes on page load
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.vote-buttons').forEach(container => {
                const key = `vote_${container.dataset.g}_${container.dataset.a}_${container.dataset.act}`;
                const previousVote = localStorage.getItem(key);
                if (previousVote) {
                    const btn = container.querySelector(`[data-v="${previousVote}"]`);
                    if (btn) btn.classList.add(previousVote === 'up' ? 'voted' : 'voted-down');
                }
            });
        });

        // Handle vote clicks - Simple image beacon approach
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (!e.target.classList.contains('vote-btn')) return;

            // Prevent the click from bubbling to parent elements (like summary)
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            const btn = e.target;
            const container = btn.closest('.vote-buttons');
            if (!container) return;

            const voteType = btn.dataset.v;

            // Check if already voted (locally)
            const key = `vote_${container.dataset.g}_${container.dataset.a}_${container.dataset.act}`;
            const previousVote = localStorage.getItem(key);

            if (previousVote === voteType) {
                // Same vote - do nothing
                btn.style.animation = 'shake 0.5s';
                setTimeout(() => btn.style.animation = '', 500);
                return;
            }

            // Build URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams({
                gene_id: container.dataset.g,
                annotation_id: container.dataset.a,
                ref_id: container.dataset.r || '',
                action: container.dataset.act,
                vote: voteType,
                session_id: sessionId,
                ua: navigator.userAgent.substring(0, 100)
            });

            // Clear previous vote styling
            container.querySelectorAll('.vote-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('voted', 'voted-down');
            });

            // Apply new vote styling immediately (optimistic UI)
            btn.classList.add(voteType === 'up' ? 'voted' : 'voted-down');

            // Store locally
            localStorage.setItem(key, voteType);

            // Send vote using fetch with no-cors mode (fire and forget)
            const fullUrl = VOTE_URL + '?' + params;
            console.log('Sending vote to:', fullUrl);

            // Use fetch in no-cors mode - we won't get a response but the request will be sent
            fetch(fullUrl, {
                mode: 'no-cors',
                method: 'GET'
            }).then(() => {
                console.log('Vote request sent (no response due to no-cors mode)');
            }).catch(err => {
                console.warn('Vote may not have been recorded, but saved locally:', err);

                // Fallback: try image beacon as well
                const img = new Image();
                img.src = fullUrl;
            });
        });

        // Optional: Add shake animation for feedback
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
            @keyframes shake {
                0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
                25% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
                75% { transform: translateX(5px); }
            }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    </script>
